package transpiler

import "testing"

// Class, method and local T declarations retain distinct Go aliases in clone
// receiver/allocation types. Captures stay shallow; most-derived self is rewired.
func TestObjectCloneShadowedLocalAliasesStrictJVM(t *testing.T) {
	files := map[string]string{"pom.xml": `<project><groupId>clonealias</groupId><artifactId>clonealias</artifactId><version>1</version></project>`, "src/main/java/clonealias/Main.java": `package clonealias;
interface ClassMark { int classCode(); }
interface MethodMark { int methodCode(); }
interface LocalMark { int localCode(); }
class ClassValue implements ClassMark {
 final int value; ClassValue(int value) { this.value=value; }
 public int classCode() { return value; }
}
class MethodValue implements MethodMark {
 final int value; MethodValue(int value) { this.value=value; }
 public int methodCode() { return value; }
}
class LocalValue implements LocalMark {
 final int value; LocalValue(int value) { this.value=value; }
 public int localCode() { return value; }
}
class Outer<T extends ClassMark> {
 final T classValue;
 Outer(T value) { classValue=value; }
 <T extends MethodMark> String probe(T methodValue) throws CloneNotSupportedException {
  final int[] capture={5};
  class Local<T extends LocalMark> implements java.lang.Cloneable {
   final T localValue;
   final Object shared;
   final Local<T> originalSelf=this;
   volatile int cell=3;
   int own=1;
   Local(T value,Object shared) { Main.constructions++; localValue=value; this.shared=shared; }
   Local<T> copy() throws CloneNotSupportedException { return (Local<T>)super.clone(); }
   boolean retains(Local<T> source) { return localValue==source.localValue && shared==source.shared && originalSelf==source; }
   int read() { return classValue.classCode()*100+methodValue.methodCode()*10+localValue.localCode()+capture[0]+own; }
  }
  class Child extends Local<LocalValue> {
   int child=7;
   Child(LocalValue value,Object shared) { super(value,shared); }
   int read() { return super.read()+child; }
  }
  Child source=new Child(new LocalValue(4),classValue);
  Local<LocalValue> copy=source.copy();
  boolean faithful=copy!=source && copy instanceof Child && copy.getClass()==source.getClass() && copy.retains(source) && Main.constructions==1;
  ((Child)copy).child=9; copy.own=2; copy.cell=8; capture[0]=6;
  synchronized(source) { System.out.println(Thread.holdsLock(source)+":"+Thread.holdsLock(copy)); }
  return faithful+":"+source.read()+":"+copy.read()+":"+source.cell+":"+copy.cell;
 }
}
public class Main {
 static int constructions;
 public static void main(String[] args) throws CloneNotSupportedException {
  System.out.println(new Outer<ClassValue>(new ClassValue(2)).probe(new MethodValue(3)));
 }
}
`}
	runCampaignCompilerStrictProjectOracle47Args(t, files, "clonealias.Main", "true:false\ntrue:248:251:3:8\n")
}
